# Examples of the libraries in libraries.txt that are expected not to
# build, one per line: the board (or * for every board), then the
# example's path under the libraries directory, then why.
#
# compile_third_party.sh fails on any other failure, and on an example
# listed here that now builds.

# BLE: need the ArduinoBLE or Adafruit Bluefruit library, and a BLE radio
# none of these boards has
*  Adafruit_NeoPixel/examples/StrandtestArduinoBLE/StrandtestArduinoBLE.ino
*  Adafruit_NeoPixel/examples/StrandtestArduinoBLECallback/StrandtestArduinoBLECallback.ino
*  Adafruit_NeoPixel/examples/StrandtestBLE/StrandtestBLE.ino
*  Adafruit_NeoPixel/examples/StrandtestBLE_nodelay/StrandtestBLE_nodelay.ino

# needs the Adafruit_ADXL343 library, which isn't in libraries.txt
*  Adafruit_Unified_Sensor/examples/sensortest/sensortest.ino

# ESP8266 only (ESP8266WiFi.h)
*  PubSubClient/examples/mqtt_esp8266/mqtt_esp8266.ino
*  PubSubClient/examples/mqtt_large_message/mqtt_large_message.ino

# needs the SRAM library (SRAM.h), which isn't in libraries.txt
*  PubSubClient/examples/mqtt_stream/mqtt_stream.ino

# use Serial1, which FRDM-MCXC444 doesn't have (Serial is both the USB
# serial and D0/D1)
frdm_mcxc444  Adafruit_BusIO/examples/genericdevice_uartregtest/genericdevice_uartregtest.ino
frdm_mcxc444  Adafruit_BusIO/examples/genericdevice_uarttest/genericdevice_uarttest.ino
